intro: CookieYes is a consent management platform configured via app.cookieyes.com. It injects a banner script and optionally blocks other scripts. Changes are applied by republishing; no developer deployment is needed for banner or category changes.

sections.title: Review cookie categories
steps: Log in to app.cookieyes.com and open your site.

Go to Cookies → Cookie List. Check that every cookie in the CRITICAL findings is assigned to the correct non-necessary category (Analytics, Advertisement, Functional, or Performance). Miscategorised cookies will not be blocked correctly.
Enable 'Block cookies before consent' if not already enabled (Settings → Cookie Blocking).

sections.title: Enable script blocking
steps: In CookieYes, go to Settings → Script Manager. Add the scripts responsible for setting non-essential cookies and map them to the correct category.
For Google Analytics: the GA script should be categorised as Analytics. CookieYes will prevent it loading until the user accepts analytics cookies.
If you use Google Tag Manager, install the CookieYes GTM integration and use CookieYes consent variables as tag triggers.

sections.title: Add a Reject button to the first layer
steps: In the CookieYes dashboard, go to Customise → Buttons.
Add a 'Reject' button alongside 'Accept'. Ensure it is on the same visible layer as 'Accept' with equal visual prominence.
Republish and verify in a fresh private browser window.
